title: NonStationaryBrachistochrone: reproducibility package for controlled-rail brachistochrones in non-stationary spacetimes
description:
Symbolic derivations, numerical verification scripts, figure-generation code, laboratory design studies, and manuscript sources for controlled-rail brachistochrones in non-stationary spacetimes. The repository supports the companion studies of the FLRW and Vaidya sectors and of the conformal Kerr (Thakurta-Kerr) sector.

1.7.2 - every script the manuscripts name, run and checked against what they print. A correction release. It follows a pass that executed each script cited in either paper and compared its output with the number the text quotes.

Two cited checks had no code. ThakurtaMetric/tk_sep_offshell_elliptic.py and VaidyaMetric/vaidya_sep_offshell_elliptic.py contained only a description of the check they were cited for. Both are now executable at thirty digits, each with a control that must fail: the degeneration S = (r - r_d)^2 Q4, the cancellation of the spurious pole at r_d, and the collapse of the letters U_k and W_jk to their elliptic form. The Thakurta-Kerr check now includes the exterior retrograde separatrix r_d = 3.514M, which carries the physical statement and had not been checked before.

Two verification scripts misreported. paper1/verification/verify_section44_closedform.py evaluated the tortoise term of the assembled closed form at the upper limit only, while the printed formula takes it between the limits; the formula agrees with the quadrature to 5e-40, and the script now says so and fails without the bracket. paper1/verification/verify_jacobi_conjugate.wls printed a spurious FAIL for want of the assumption that the scale factor is positive.

Every quoted residual traced to a script. Each number the papers quote without naming a script was traced, re-run and compared. Five had no archived script and now have one: KerrScripts/kerr_tbranch_separatrix_sigma_eval.wls (the t-branch separatrix closed form in Mathematica's Weierstrass functions at forty digits, better than 1e-46 on five arcs, with a control that must fail), kerr_tbranch_genus2_periods.sage.py, kerr_marginal_convergence.py, bvp_missed_roots_highprecision.py and VaidyaMetric/vaidya_tau_spectral_check.py. Where the reproduced value differed from the printed one, the papers now give the reproduced value; two statements with no archived source were withdrawn.

Paper I, proper-time blocks relabelled. The mass of ingoing Vaidya runs with the advanced time, so the drift is weighted by v on every branch. The appendix block that feeds the proper-time density to the block formula is now presented as an algebraic instance, and the v-weighted block as the physical response.

Stated precision brought to what reproduces. The theta-ratio form of the third-kind letter had been quoted at 5e-8; the archived double-precision check gives 7e-5, and the text now rests that identity on Fay's representation of the normalised third-kind differential. separatrix_classification.py applies the selector criterion r_d > 2M stated in the text, not r_d > r_+. A few quoted residuals and one percentage were corrected to the scripts' output, the result-to-script table no longer claims that every entry is generated by the provenance command, and unproven irreducibility statements in Paper I are stated as conjectures, as in Paper II.

What did not change. No theorem, closed form or figure changes. The provenance check regenerates the manifest and the adiabatic slopes identically, and the computer-assisted certificates reproduce with identical subdivision counts. Thirty-one manifest entries; content digest 42ed5ab1779c5813.
